DEF-190.title: Repeated buyer seat identifiers across SeatBid objects are not diagnosed
DEF-190.expected: OpenRTB 2.6 section 4.2.2 describes multiple SeatBid objects as representing different buyer seats. Repeating a seat identifier across separate SeatBid objects should be diagnosed; multiple bids within one seat remain valid.
DEF-190.actual: The response validator and crosscheck do not compare seatbid[].seat identifiers. The repeated-seat control produces no corresponding finding.
notes: Repeated Bid.id tracking values are separately exercised as a robustness control. Their uniqueness scope is not specified by the cited Bid field description and is not included in this defect.
